# Kettlebell Tracker Pro

> > A web-based workout logging tool designed specifically for kettlebell training, featuring PR tracking, EMOM/AMRAP workout support, and progress monitoring.

Kettlebell Tracker Pro helps athletes track kettlebell-specific exercises like swings and snatches, log personal records, and monitor training progress through an intuitive dashboard interface.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell Tracker Pro
- Workout logging
- Personal records (PR tracking)
- EMOM (Every Minute on the Minute)
- AMRAP (As Many Reps As Possible)
- Kettlebell swings
- Kettlebell snatches
- Training dashboard
- Progress monitoring
- Kettlebell training
- Fitness tracking
- Web-based workout tracker

## Core Application

- [Kettlebell Tracker Pro — Simple tools for serious training](https://mykettlebelltracker.com): Homepage for Kettlebell Tracker Pro workout logging and PR tracking tool
- [Kettlebell Tracker Pro - Track Your Workouts & Progress](https://mykettlebelltracker.com/tracker): Main app interface for logging kettlebell workouts and monitoring progress
